· Current price (183,100 KRW) below SMA5 (192,360 KRW), SMA20 (208,065 KRW), SMA50 (233,184 KRW) - short/mid-term trend diagnosed as weak.
· Below SMA100 (246,501 KRW), SMA200 (238,009 KRW) - long-term trend weakness continues.
· 52-week position (31.6%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.3→34.8) + entered oversold + downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (87.7348→-536.7635) + diagnosed as worsening + signal of continued downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 176,105 KRW) + band width at 30.72% interpreted.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (179,200 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (158,533 KRW).
· Swing resistance level (209,000 KRW) + potential approach to mid-band upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + interpreted as an attempt to recover.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.30x) + increased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + condition to watch for resistance at 209,000 KRW before considering entry.
